# Documents

Project document intelligence workspace.

- `inbox/`: managed copies of source documents.
- `manifests/`: hash, parser, authority, status, and version metadata.
- `extracted/`: parsed sections and proposed extracted intelligence.
- `reviews/`: Document Analyst and Document Reviewer outputs.
- `processed/`: promotion records and change-impact outputs.
- `rejected/`: rejected document records.
- `runs/`: resumable document processing state.
